format: Canonical file (contracts/formulation-clock.md §6). Instants are UTC; 'days' are 86 400-second spans. classification: expect holds the class and the derived instants. transitions: expect lists the fields that must hold after the event (unlisted fields equal before); an 'error' expect means the event is refused and nothing changes; an 'applied: false' expect means auto-park does not apply and nothing changes; 'bulk_clock_before' is the clock the bulk-release record stores; 'expect_settings' lists owner inputs after the event; 'expect_derived' lists the class and instants evaluated at 'now' after the event; 'follows' names the vector whose result is 'before'. queue_order: the asks_for_decision aggregate in §5 queue order. Edit the canonical file and both copies in one commit (§6).

en dash Pd becomes a space
İ folds to i + U+0307, unlike i

NFKC expands … to dots, which become spaces

queue_order.note: earliest-asking first: by ask_at, then start, then id; an extended and a due-paused task sort by when they actually asked
equal ask_at: the earlier formulation_started_at goes first, even with the later id
